_comment: Copper Peptide Advanced Night Repair Cream, 2026-08-20. NOTE the jar is PALE ICE-BLUE with BLACK text, where the Day cream jar is DEEP NAVY with WHITE text. Same line, same carton blue, opposite container treatment - assuming the Day cream's colours here would invert the whole label.
product_desc: Skingenetix Copper Peptide Advanced Night Repair: a 50ml frosted PALE ICE-BLUE glass cosmetic jar, wide and squat - noticeably WIDER THAN IT IS TALL, about 1.15 times wider than its full height - with a deep brushed satin aluminium screw lid. The glass is a soft pale ice-blue, slightly deeper at the shoulders and lighter towards the base. Keep it PALE BLUE and do not render it deep navy, white, teal or purple - this is the light jar of the pair, not the dark one. The lid is a tall band standing about a THIRD of the jar's total height and roughly HALF the height of the glass body beneath it; not a thin disc or a shallow cap. The lid metal is NEUTRAL SILVER-GREY with a fine brushed grain - never rose-gold, copper, champagne, brass or warm-tinted, and never a chrome mirror. Reproduce the front label exactly as in the reference, every character verbatim. These are the ONLY words on the jar, in this order: (1) the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark with the wordmark 'Skingenetix', capital S then lower case, no trademark or copyright symbol anywhere; (2) 'COPPER PEPTIDE' - bold capitals, one line; (3) 'ADVANCED NIGHT REPAIR'; (4) 'PREMIUM FORMULA'; (5) a small crescent-moon glyph then 'NIGHT CREAM  |  2% GHK-CU  |  50ML'. A narrow vertical rule sits to the left of the text block. INK COLOURS - these describe the ink each line is printed in and are NEVER themselves printed as words: the mark, wordmark, line 2, line 4 and line 5 are printed in BLACK ink; line 3 and the vertical rule are printed in strong royal-blue ink. No colour name appears as text. THE JAR CARRIES ONLY THE LINES LISTED ABOVE - not the benefit triplet, not 'ALL SKIN TYPES', not any ingredient list. Those are carton-only. BRAND ACCENT COLOUR: BLUE. Any brand colour, gradient or accent glow builds from that blue and cool neutrals - never gold, rose, purple, green or orange.
_packaging_desc_help: The carton is the same medium steel blue as the Day cream's, DARKER than this pale jar.
packaging_desc:
The product carton is a WIDE, SHORT rectangular box - broader than it is tall, sized to hold a squat 50ml jar. It has TWO large faces in different colours meeting at crisp edges, each colour holding right up to the edge. One large face is matte metallic MEDIUM STEEL BLUE - a denim blue, distinctly DARKER than the jar's pale ice-blue; the other is matte metallic brushed pale silver - not white cardboard, not a mirror. Both large faces carry the SAME lines, in this order top to bottom, and these are the ONLY words printed on them:
1. the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark with the wordmark 'Skingenetix'
2. 'COPPER PEPTIDE' - bold capitals, one line
3. 'ADVANCED NIGHT REPAIR' - bold capitals
4. 'ANTI-AGING  |  FIRMING  |  REPAIRING'
5. 'PREMIUM FORMULA  |  ALL SKIN TYPES'
6. a small crescent-moon glyph then 'NIGHT CREAM  |  2% GHK-CU  |  50ML' - small capitals
A narrow vertical rule sits to the left of the text block.
INK COLOURS - these describe the ink each line is printed in and are NEVER themselves printed as words. On the steel-blue face: lines 1 and 3, the 'ALL SKIN TYPES' half of line 5, and the vertical rule are printed in white ink; everything else in black ink. On the silver face: those same elements are printed in steel-blue ink and the rule is steel blue, everything else black. No colour name appears as text.
The narrow side panels are printed in the same steel blue and silver and carry ingredient and directions text too small to read - render it as fine unreadable print, never as placeholder words. FINISH: a luxury matte-metallic satin stock. Render a soft brushed sheen with broad diffuse falloff across each face - never a mirror, never polished foil, never chrome. PRINT NOTHING NOT LISTED ABOVE - do not invent, translate, paraphrase or add wording, claims or ingredient names on any face.
